text: それでは　どんなに　がんばっても　トップ　には　たてんぞ！

structure.jp: どんなに　がんばっても
structure.en: no matter how hard you try

structure.jp: トップ　には　たてんぞ！
structure.en: you can't stand at the top!

patterns.name: どんなに〜ても
patterns.span: どんなに　がんばっても
patterns.explanation: どんなに with a て-form verb and も means 'no matter how much'. どんなに　がんばっても = 'no matter how hard you try'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: たてる is the 'can stand' form of たつ, and ん is an old-man short form of ない. たてん = 'can't stand'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way of warning or driving a point home. たてんぞ = 'you won't be able to stand there, I tell you!'.
